top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) honours induced proximity as a new, catalytic, event-driven chemical mode of action, with the ternary-complex and E3-recruitment mechanism reproduced across laboratories and cereblon explaining thalidomide-type glues already acting in patients. One citation covers both PROTAC and glue arms under a shared principle, and the three-name allocation spans concept and mechanism. P003 (orthogonal translation) is the mature, cleanly attributed fallback if timing is judged premature, ahead of P002 (C-N cross-coupling), which extends a class recognised in 2010; any award is preferred to P000.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; documented tie to Arieh Warshel (postdoctoral EVB collaboration) concerns no credited laureate, and none is linked to Uppsala University
